nonblocking_notes: Onlyfour independent data draws andtwo fixed generators; both teachers occur in training folds. Discovery LODO is not confirmation, unseen-teacher/domain transfer, or64iid repeats; no rowwise significance or tightCI is supported.

Known LeafRefit-type conditional replay, per-new-tree EFC adaptation, operator noise gain, collision floor and norm identity are not new scientific results. No novelty, first-priority, universal mechanism or journal-readiness conclusion is accepted by this preflight.

Synthetic teacher labels are descriptive quality diagnostics only; primary target is finite-label-response approximation discrepancy on unlabeled evaluation covariates. This does not measure causal extra variance or prove that perturbation harms prediction quality.
Rounded native-label directions differ from ideal Gaussian perturbations. Frobenius expectation is not automatically exact for their actual rounding law.

P3 is conditional on an available full basefit/frozen operator and environment-specific measured timings. Shared/evidence/forecast/discovery costs must stay visible; a cheap standalone service or universal speedup does not follow.

Preflight code/pure fixtures cannot establish actual plot legibility, full matrix completion, native model agreement, empirical effect or useful forecast range. Actual raw-evidence recomputation and visual QA are required before REPORT acceptance/close.

If A fails any frozen forecast/cost/range gate, stop this candidate and retain negative/inconclusive outcome. Do not promote B3/B4 or alter grids/alphas/endpoints post hoc into a new positive claim. Positive discovery permits only separately frozen new-data confirmation.

This stage addresses one bounded question about applicability of a boosting explanation; full original cross-model double-descent research remains incomplete even if its engineering and discovery gates pass.
